post.summary: Rank top recyclers for an e-waste lot
post.description:
Evaluates verified candidates against hard constraints (authorization, category, location)

and applies multi-criteria scoring to return the top 3 ranked buyers.

post.summary: Initiate verifiable handover and generate signed QR payload
post.description:
Collector initiates handover, producing a unique 6-character short code

and a tamper-evident HMAC-SHA256 signed QR payload.

post.summary: Recycler confirms physical handover via QR scan or short code
post.description:
Recycler confirms physical handover by scanning the signed QR code or entering the 6-character code.

Enforces weight mismatch tolerance (10%) and appends to the immutable hash chain.

post.summary: Update EPR downstream processing lifecycle stage
post.description: Updates downstream lifecycle progress (received -> dismantled -> processed -> certificate_issued).

get.summary: Public verification of handover authenticity and cryptographic integrity
get.description:
Allows any stakeholder or auditor to verify the authenticity, weight, and status

of an e-waste handover record using its 6-character reference code without authentication.
